Tip: pick the Solid look and set "Real me showing through" to about half, then line the skull up with your face.

    


    
The anatomy is a real 3D dataset of one adult, scaled and pinned to your head. The head is 3D; the hands and body skeleton are 3D bones from the same dataset, stretched to fit your tracked joints. It shows where structures typically sit, not a scan of you, and it is not a medical tool. Video is processed on this computer and never uploaded.
